My value is $27, significantly higher than the possible values of the other bidders (who can have values between $0 and $20). Thus, I should bid slightly above $20 to ensure I win the auction. I will bid $20.10. This guarantees a profit of $27 - $20.10 = $6.90.

My value is $14. I want to win if and only if my value is greater than the second highest bid. I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win, but not so low that I frequently lose. A good starting point is to bid around 90% of my value. This gives me a decent chance of winning while still ensuring a reasonable profit.
